source.author: verg
source.text: Siquid mea carmina possunt, nulla dies umquam memori vos eximet aevo, dum domus Aeneae Capitoli immobile saxum accolet imperiumque pater Romanus habebit.
source.text_original: Siquid mea carmina possunt, / nulla dies umquam memori vos eximet aevo, / dum domus Aeneae Capitoli immobile saxum / accolet imperiumque pater Romanus habebit.
source.text_english: If my songs can do anything, no day will ever erase you from a mindful age, so long as the house of Aeneas shall dwell beside the immovable rock of the Capitol and the Roman father shall hold sway.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: hunc finium putant habere custodiam eique publice supplicatur, ut Capitoli immobile saxum Romani imperii fines et conseruet et proroget.
reuse.text_original: hunc finium putant habere custodiam eique publice supplicatur, ut Capitoli immobile saxum Romani imperii fines et conseruet (et) proroget.
reuse.text_english: They think that he has guardianship of these boundaries, and prayers are publicly offered to him, so that he may preserve and extend the borders of the Roman empire, like the immovable stone of the Capitol.
